lesson.title: Review Day: Structures That Help Organisms Survive
lesson.subject: science

contentBlocks.text: This week you explored structures that help living things survive. Let's review it all!

Quick review: external structures are visible, like a beak or spines (Day 1). Internal structures are hidden but essential, like roots or gills (Day 2). Sense structures help organisms receive information, like eyes or ears (Day 3). The same need can lead to different structures in different environments (Day 4). Name one external structure, one internal structure, and explain why a desert plant and rainforest plant have different roots.
Wonderful work this week — you explored external, internal, and sensing structures across many organisms! Next week we'll explore something new.

objectives: Review external, internal, and sensing structures, and environment's role in shaping them
Name one example of each structure type and explain the desert/rainforest root comparison
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child name one external and one internal structure.
3. Have the child re-explain the desert/rainforest root comparison.
4. Complete the review worksheet.
5. Celebrate finishing a full week of survival-structures exploration!
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just the external/internal distinction, the most foundational of the week's ideas, before requiring the environment-comparison explanation
Ready for more: ask the child to connect this week back to last week — could a structure also help an organism use energy more efficiently?
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the week's structure types needs the most reinforcement before moving on
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recall and review activity — check that the child names a genuine external structure (beak, spines) and internal structure (roots, gills), and correctly re-explains that different water availability shapes different root structures.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's NGSS Grade 4 Life Science standards (4-LS1-1, 4-LS1-2) before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session.
